Terms of use

Reasonable use rules for this website, updated October 2026.

About this site

This website presents Enactus ARSD — the student Enactus chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi. It describes our projects, publishes our stories and directories, and lets people contact the team. It is not an online store with checkout, and no purchases or payments happen through it yet.

Accuracy

Figures and statements on this site come from chapter-published reports (our earlier site posts and official updates), labelled with their sources where relevant. We update as projects report more; if you find an error, tell us.

Using our content

  • Our writing, layout code and identity are the chapter's own work.
  • You're welcome to link to or reference what we publish, with attribution — including photos once they're here.
  • Do not republish our content as your own, fabricate partner relationships using our pages, or scrape product listings.

Enquiries and applications

Contact and recruitment forms are frontend placeholders — they pass your message to your own email app for you to send. Email the chapter directly for anything binding, and expect a human reply from the core team.

Linking out

Our Instagram, LinkedIn and Linktree links take you to platforms we don't control; their terms are theirs.

Liability

This site is informational and provided in good faith by a student team. We keep it current and correct it when alerted, but can't warranty absolute accuracy at every moment.

Contact

Questions about these terms: enactusarsdchapter@gmail.com.
